name: Center for Action and Contemplation
reason: Site refuses us: cac.org's robots.txt (read 10 Nov 2026) allows us, but the home page answered 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' bot check to a plain curl request, so nothing more was fetched from it and it was not retried (owner's blocked-means-skip rule). Without its own pages there is no usable contact route, base, offerings or teacher evidence. Channel: Data API 10 Nov 2026, 111,000 subscribers, founded by Richard Rohr in 1987 (per its YouTube description); our teachers on its channel: kaitlin-curtice, mirabai-starr, russ-hudson. Possible editorial-stature listing if the owner can reach the site another way.
